author: anistark
title: Coffee Window
description: A window seat in a late-night cafe in Night City. Your coffee steams on the counter while cars, people and the odd dog pass under the neon outside. It never plays the same way twice.
ogAlt: Coffee Window: a steaming cup on a wooden counter by a cafe window, with a neon-lit cyberpunk street outside at night
canvasLabel: Animated view from a window seat in a late-night cafe, a cup of coffee steaming on a wooden counter while cars and people pass a neon-lit street, out of focus beyond the glass
share: A window seat in a late-night cafe in Night City, with a coffee that never goes the same way twice. Mine was seeded at {seed}.

card: A window seat in a late-night cafe, with the neon street softly out of focus beyond the glass. Your coffee steams on the counter beside a daisy and a few books, you sip now and then, a little robot rises out of the counter to refill it, and sometimes a cat curls up to sleep.
